title: AIT Scholarships
field: Engineering, technology, environment and management (AIT graduate programmes)
about: The Asian Institute of Technology's AIT Scholarships, open to any nationality for master's and doctoral study, list a 10 December 2026 deadline on AIT's financial aid page. Applicants are considered automatically after submitting the online admission application.
requirements: Study levels: Master's Degree Programs, Flexible Master's Option, Flexible PhD Option, Doctoral Degree Programs
No separate scholarship application: applicants who submit the online admission application are considered for all scholarships they are eligible for whose deadline has not passed

upskill.name: the full course catalog
why: No course reached a genuine match: the shortlist hits ("no", "application", "program") were incidental words, and the record lists eligibility conditions ("Any nationality", study levels), not skills that a course objective covers.
Field "Engineering, technology, environment and management" is broad, so the catalog page is used as the closest relevant fallback, and the caption labels it as the course catalog.
